description: This file defines a React functional component 'Sidebar' used for the application's main navigation sidebar. It includes a utility function 'clearClientAuthArtifacts' to clear client-side auth tokens and session data, and the Sidebar component manages navigation and logout functionality with embedded links and a logout button. The file references React, React Router, a custom AuthContext, a Button UI component, and a CSS stylesheet.

methods.name: clearClientAuthArtifacts
methods.description: Utility function to clear specified client-side auth/session tokens from localStorage and sessionStorage to facilitate logout and session cleanup.

methods.name: Sidebar
methods.description: React component rendering a static sidebar with navigation links and a logout button; manages logout process and navigation.
